standards.title: Editorial standards
standards.intro: Trust is our first promise. These are the rules LËK’s newsroom commits to.
standards.status: Prototype working document, to be approved by the editorial leadership.

independence.title: Independence
independence.text: The newsroom alone decides what it publishes. Advertisers, partners and LËK Studios clients have no say over articles. Sponsored content is always labelled as such.

sourcing.title: Sourcing
sourcing.text: Every important fact is attributed. Sources are named wherever possible; an anonymous source is used only if known to the editor-in-chief and the information is verified independently.

verification.title: Verification
verification.text: Facts, figures and quotes are checked before publication. Images are credited; an illustration is never presented as a news photograph.

reply.title: Right of reply
reply.text: Anyone implicated is contacted before publication and their response is published.

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.text: Mistakes are corrected quickly and each correction is noted, with its date, at the foot of the article.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.text: AI may help organise research, transcribe, proofread or prepare a draft translation. It never invents facts, quotes or sources, and no article is published without human sign-off. No AI-generated image is ever presented as documentary.

translation.title: Translations
translation.text: An article is published in another language only after review by a journalist fluent in that language. Until then it stays in its original language.

standards.contactText: Spotted a mistake? Write to the newsroom with the article and passage concerned. Contact address to be confirmed before launch.

credits.intro: Every photograph on this site comes from Wikimedia Commons, under a free licence or in the public domain. They show places and everyday life.
credits.rule: None of these images documents the prototype’s fictional articles, and none was generated or altered by artificial intelligence. Every caption says so.
credits.brandText: The gold-and-night geometric patterns are abstract illustrations made for LËK Network. They are not photographs.

privacy.intro: What this prototype actually does with your data.
privacy.status: Prototype working document, to be replaced by an approved policy before launch.

collected.title: Nothing collected
collected.text: The prototype has no user accounts, no audience measurement and no advertising. It sends no personal data to LËK.

storage.title: What stays in your browser
storage.text: Your language choice (a language cookie and a local preference) and your article text size. You can clear them from your browser.

forms.text: The form checks your request but does not send it: nothing is transmitted or stored.

newsroom.title: Newsroom demonstration
newsroom.text: Demonstration drafts stay in your browser only. There is no server and no database.

thirdParty.title: Third-party services
thirdParty.text: The site is hosted by Netlify, which processes the technical connection data hosting requires. Fonts are served by the site itself. Links to Wikimedia Commons open only if you click them.

launch.title: Before launch
launch.text: A full policy (data controller, retention periods, rights of access and deletion) will be published before any real data is collected.
